context: The EU layer holds frameworks and EU-wide networks only. Aid, land banks and courses are applied for nationally or regionally and belong in country or region files.
Commission pages describe measures of a strategy (for example a European Land Observatory); record them as announced until a page shows a working service.
Commission news articles explain policy; add them as news only when they report a dated event (adoption, launch, call, new figures) of the edition year.
Farmers do not apply to EU financial instruments directly: they are offered through national or regional guarantee and loan schemes, which belong in country or region files.

Use the Commission's catalogue of CAP interventions and its generational-renewal study annex to discover candidates for ES, FR, DE, IT and PT. Before admitting one, follow it to the national or regional managing authority, check that authority's reuse and linking terms, eligibility, operation and application route, and compare it with existing resource IDs. An inventory row is not itself an EU-wide benefit or evidence that applications are open.

log.summary: First pass: reviewed the three Commission and EU CAP Network portals and wrote the 2026 EU edition with three resources; no 2026 EU event verified as news.
Resolved the two open leads: the Observatory on Farmland recorded as announced; EIB instruments rejected at EU level.

Prepublication discovery: ran prepublication-2026-09-25 queries. This is a search-result scan, not a complete review or evidence of absence. Candidate pages, all families and practical details still require verification. The scan does not update edition statuses or dates.

Retained Annex II as a discovery source for the five existing countries and future separately authorised expansion. EU-wide applicability remains distinct from national programmes mentioned by an EU report. No full EU re-review or edition changes.

Added the Commission's CAP intervention catalogue as a licensed discovery portal for the five current countries, with a primary-authority and duplication check before admitting any candidate. No edition resources or statuses changed.

Reviewed Annex II of the EU CAP Network generational-renewal assessment as a second licensed discovery portal; recorded its five-country aggregate and admission limits in a research memo. No annex rows were treated as active instruments or added to the edition.

Admitted two pages a ChatGPT suggestion pass proposed and Claude opened in a browser: the Commission's gateway to each country's CAP Strategic Plan, and the fi-compass toolkit addressed to young and new farmers preparing a loan application. Unlike the fi-compass material rejected on 2026-09-14, which targets managing authorities, this toolkit is written for farmers themselves.

Re-read the young farmers, Strategy, CAP Strategic Plans, fi-compass and EU CAP Network pages in a browser and added the quoted facts a farmer needs: the EU young farmer definition, CISYF and where to apply; the Strategy's proposed Starter Pack and 2040 goal; quotes for claims the records already made but did not support. Budget shares and targets were left out, since they are not what a farmer receives.
The NEWBIE project page links to an interactive browser of practical farm-entry cases from several European countries.

The Newbie page provides access to practical online toolkits explicitly intended for new entrants, successors and advisors. Added the toolkit collection as an advice resource, distinct from the existing EU resources; the page does not establish the operator's legal type.
